Steeled Veterans is a Premium Warbond available for 1,000 Super Credits in the Warbonds tab of the Acquisition Center.

Overview

Players can use Medals to claim various items, including a booster, 5 weapons, 3 armors, 7 cosmetics, and 300 Super Credits. These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 2 to 80). Players start on page one, unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options.

Notes

There are also Steeled Veterans themed items in the Permanent Catalog on the Superstore.

Trivia

  • The Steeled Veterans Premium Warbond was previously included in the Super Citizen Edition DLC. This was later replaced with a Premium Warbond Token which entitles the player to 1 free Premium Warbond of their choice. Legendary Warbonds are not eligible.
  • The warbonds name is likely a pun based on a scene from the original Starship Troopers film. In the recruitment scene, Rico is congratulated on his placement in the Mobile Infantry by a triple-amputee officer played by Robert David Hall (a double-amputee in real life). He says "Good for you. Mobile Infantry made me the man I am today." as the camera conspicuously pans down past his prosthetic arm to his missing legs.
    • The warbond includes the first instances of armor which gives the player character prosthetic limbs.
